g.text: SSD1306 I2C breakout: VCC, SDA, SCL, GND

g.desc: SSD1306 I2C breakout: VCC, SDA, SCL, GND

g.text: J1 pin order: VCC, SDA, SCL, GND. Connect SDA to Uno A4/SDA and SCL to A5/SCL. The reference module is powered from Uno 3.3 V with pull-ups to 3.3 V; address 0x3C is selected in the firmware.

g.desc: J1 pin order: VCC, SDA, SCL, GND. Connect SDA to Uno A4/SDA and SCL to A5/SCL. The reference module is powered from Uno 3.3 V with pull-ups to 3.3 V; address 0x3C is selected in the firmware.

g.text: Check the exact breakout: some boards use 0x3D, different controllers or different voltage arrangements. Do not expose the module to 5 V pull-ups unless it is rated for them. ERC and exact-net checks cover only this logical drawing; no display was tested.
